explanation: Verified: about 300 ms. There is one loop and it was inside the first handler, so everything behind it waited — which in a real application is the interface freezing, because repaint is an event too. Anything over about 100 ms is noticeable and anything over a second reads as broken. Every unresponsive program you have used was a handler that took too long.
